roster.name: FAIR Genomes metadata schema (FAIR Genomes semantic model)
roster.description: A semantic metadata schema for NGS genomic data (v1.1): ~110 elements in 9 modules to describe patients, clinical data, samples, assays, analysis procedures, consent and access conditions. Represented as a core YAML model convertible to JSON/RDF/templates for EDCs and programmatic interfaces; reuses ontologies such as NCIT, DUO and EDAM to enable machine-readable FAIRification in healthcare and research.
